pages.title: Alchemy Table
pages.text: A workbench for basic alchemy operations. $(br)When materials are laid out, it takes one second to create an item.

pages.title: Hermes's Workbench
pages.text: An advanced workbench with a 5x5 crafting grid. $(br)When the materials are laid out, it takes 2 seconds to create an item.

pages.title: Transcendental Table
pages.text: A workbench with a massive 13x13 crafting grid. $(br)When the materials are laid out, it takes 3 seconds to create an item.
